explication: MLMVPN is a Windows anti-censorship desktop environment combining connection engines, clean-IP discovery, Cloudflare infrastructure tools, and network/game diagnostics. The principal user journey is choosing a route or engine, measuring whether it works, and connecting through the selected tunnel; scanning can also find and validate clean CDN addresses for configurations. The graph includes documented capabilities whose source was not sampled, but leaves their internal links out. Dashed edges mark product-level relationships not visible in the excerpts or source index.
